verdict.rationale: Shopify documents an official POS UI extensions API on shopify.dev. It covers tiles, actions and blocks targets, a runtime surface (shopify.storage, shopify.toast, shopify.action.presentModal), Shopify CLI scaffolding, and direct GraphQL Admin API access via fetch(). Together these form an official SDK developers can build against for the POS. missing for 10: evidence of language-specific client SDKs or libraries beyond the extension runtime, AI-native workflow tooling tied to the SDK, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the developer experience.
